# Easy Peeze Tools — llms-full.txt

Generated: 2026-09-09
Source: https://easypeeze.com/
Index: https://easypeeze.com/llms.txt

Easy Peeze Tools makes simple privacy-first apps: Pdf Buddy (100% local Windows PDF editor, 3 free actions/day, then INR 299/year or INR 999 lifetime) and Kharch Log (Android expense tracker on Google Sheets, INR 149 lifetime). Site: easypeeze.com - expenses product also at kharchlog.com.

## Facts

- Brand: Easy Peeze Tools
- Pdf Buddy: Windows 10/11 desktop PDF editor, local-first (no upload required for edits)
- Pdf Buddy free: 3 actions/day; paid: INR 299/year or INR 999 lifetime
- Kharch Log: Android UPI/SMS expense tracker -> your Google Sheet; INR 149 lifetime
- Support: easypeezetools@gmail.com
- Kharch site: https://kharchlog.com/
